steps.note: Enable eRFX project creation for the test.
Apply the setting whose effect on the saved draft is being tested.
Apply the case's required company configuration.
Give the draft a searchable title.
Configure the eRFX draft with an RFQ stage.
Configure the RFQ stage before selecting its template.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the draft can be saved.
Add the minimum line item required for a valid draft.
Commit a schedule so the draft has its required event configuration.
Save the eRFX event as an unpublished draft.
Confirm the draft save did not produce an application error.
Navigate to the Events list to reopen the saved draft.
Open the Drafts tab as required by the case.
Open the draft created by this plan.
Check that the vendor-add “+” control is not offered; the catalog does not define its exact accessible label.
